notes:
CHR-889. Screens view of a freshly created project with zero screens. Variant A (approved by Christian): numbered how-to-start guide inside the white screen frame. Exploration history: mockup `empty-project-canvas`.

Layout: Screens panel stays expanded (280px) but empty — filter field + "0 screens · 0 mockups", no "No screens yet." text; Context and Elements are 36px icon rails (CHR-888, same markup as sidebars-collapsed); the grey "No screens yet." column is gone. Canvas = $color.canvas, empty 390x844 frame at the default 50% zoom (rendered 195x422: a 195x422 `frame-box` holding the 390x844 frame with transform: scale(0.5)).

Final copy (English):
- Label: "GET STARTED"
- Title: "Design your first screen"
- 1: "Ask your AI tool to design a screen in this project."
  Prompt block (mono): "Design a login screen in my Artisign project delete-me"  [Copy]
- 2: "Watch it appear here while the agent works."
- 3: "Review it. Use Comment mode to leave feedback the agent reads."
- Caption under the frame ("390 × 844 · 50%") is a design-file annotation only, not product UI.

Guide sizes in frame px (scale 1; half on screen at 50%) — inline literals, no token exists: frame padding 40px 32px, block gap 28px, step gap 22px/14px; label 15px uppercase, letter-spacing 0.04em; title 34px, line-height 1.2; step text 22px, line-height 1.4; number badge 33px circle, 18.7px; prompt mono 18px, padding 12.6px 14.4px; Copy 14.4px. Tokens: $color.text-label (label), $color.text / $typography.weight-semibold (title), $color.text-secondary (steps, prompt), $color.accent on $color.accent-subtle with $radius.pill (badge), $color.surface-subtle + $color.border + $radius.sm + $typography.family-mono (prompt block, same look as empty-ai in no-project-empty-state), $color.border-strong (Copy), $color.surface + $color.border-strong + $radius.md + $shadow.menu (frame), $color.canvas.

Behaviour: the guide renders only while the project has zero screens and disappears live the moment the first screen arrives (the frame then renders that screen, no reload). The prompt uses the active project name (replaces "delete-me"). Copy copies exactly the prompt text and the label flips to "Copied" for ~1.5s; the prompt is also selectable. Type is authored at ~2x so it reads at the 50% default; at 100%/200% the guide scales up with the frame (accepted tradeoff).

Design-file artefact: `$topbar` has no slot for the project name or zoom state, so it renders "artisign-ui" and Fit active here; in the product the picker shows the open project (e.g. delete-me) and 50% is active (the default zoom for this state).
